newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican state denies reports of armed clash.
newsitem.headline: Mexican state denies reports of armed clash.

text.p: Officials in the southern Mexican state of Chiapas denied reports on Friday of an armed clash in the area between rebels and government security forces.

"Since the morning we have checked with the different villages in the area and no, there is nothing going on," said local official Gustavo Morales Espinoza in the town of Ocosingo, about 460 miles (700 km) southeast of Mexico City.
The pro-government Televisa television network said it had received a news agency report of a battle between rebels and troops near the village of Patihuitz, east of Ocosingo.
Televisa said it had no confirmation of the report.

Leaders of Chiapas' Zapatista rebels and legislative representatives were meeting on Friday in the city of San Cristobal de las Casas in an attempt to restart stalled peace talks between the rebels and the government.
